subject: Avoid UB in slot-entry parsing of cluster config (#4100)
reason: This is a UB/robustness fix confined to clusterLoadConfig, the nodes.conf text parser, which runs only once at startup (src/cluster_legacy.c:1499). It is unreachable by any installed experiment or writable one, and would false-positive if forced. The changed branches are entered only by a *corrupted* cluster config file, and on every such input both builds terminate the process: the fmterr label calls serverPanic("...corrupted cluster config file...") (src/cluster_legacy.c:1050), an abort the liveness oracle flags as a crash. The fix does not make the server survive corrupt config -- it still
